label: Imbalance of Excitatory and Inhibitory Neurotransmitter Systems in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
summary: Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) and post-COVID-19 syndrome share a symptom profile, including severe fatigue, cognitive dysfunction, exertional intolerance, sleep disturbances, hypervigilance, and the paradoxical state of being "wired but tired." A well-established finding is sympathetic hyperactivity with reduced vagal tone, typically interpreted as autonomic nervous system dysfunction.
